android.desc:
RaceTime – Simplifies race management and timing

RaceTime is the ultimate tool for race organizers, designed to make managing competitions with many participants smooth, fast, and efficient. Whether you’re timing a small local event or a large-scale race, RaceTime helps you handle it all — without the stress.

Key Features:
• Easy participant management: Add participants manually, import CSV files, or instantly create a dedicated registration page for your event — shareable as a link in seconds. Collect entries and payments online, all in one place.
• Flexible start options: Organize individual or group starts with ease.
• Supports the calculation of results for both individual and team competitions.
• Splits view lets you see checkpoint-by-checkpoint times for every athlete.
• Accurate timing: Record athletes, crossing the finish line, in multiple ways, reducing errors and simplifying your most important task.
• Real-time results: Stand out with instant results updates for a professional race day experience.
• Team collaboration: Invite staff and timekeepers to help run your event. Build a team that help you to manage the event and handling checkpoints.
• Multi-device support: With a Pro subscription, use unlimited devices at finish line and checkpoints for seamless coordination.
